items.title: Former Alibaba exec’s Everful raises $48.5M to connect retailers with Chinese factories
items.summary: Everful has raised $48.5 million to expand its factory-direct sourcing platform, helping retailers source products from overseas manufacturers.
items.creator: Kate Park

items.title: Anthropic hits NASDAQ exchange at $110, $27 above IPO price
items.summary: Anthropic's IPO price was set at $83, representing more than $80 billion in new capital raised.
items.creator: Russell Brandom

items.title: At Nasdaq opening bell, Anthropic CEO recommits to pacing AI development
items.summary: In his Nasdaq opening bell speech, Dario Amodei reiterated Anthropic's commitment to pacing AI development, regardless of business or political pressure.
items.creator: Sarah Perez
